sentences.text: I cannot determine whether section 8.2 complies because the text of section 8.2 was not provided.
For a Tier 3 UCB, the current applicable rule says penal interest is not permitted, while penal charges are permitted only under the stated conditions.
The older RBI penal-charges circulars are no longer in force on 2026-11-23 because they were withdrawn, so they do not control the current answer.

The older circulars also said penalty for non-compliance of material loan terms should be treated as penal charges and should not be levied as penal interest added to the rate of interest, and the quantum and reason for penal charges should be clearly disclosed.

missing.searched: Retail Loan Policy section 8.2 on penal interest/penal charges
